rationale: BEAM is trading at the absolute top of its intraday range (position 100%) after a massive ~15% intraday move on 3.98x relative volume with no news catalyst identified, making the risk/reward asymmetric and difficult to assess directionally. The last 5 candles show very tight, low-volume consolidation just under the high with a minor volume spike on the penultimate candle, but there is no clear breakout confirmation nor a clean pullback entry for a long, and shorting into a strong momentum move at the high without a clear reversal signal carries significant squeeze risk. With today's realized P&L already negative and an existing working order consuming capital, preserving the loss budget is prudent here.
